title: Haɗa tebur kuma tabbatar da ƙara yawan lambobin ku

say: Haɗa tebur, kuma tabbatar da ƙara yawan lambobin ku.
Wannan shi ne bidiyon don module 2 na SQL Fundamentals: Kayan aiki, Haɗuwa da Sakamako Masu Amintacce.
Kuna koyon SQL ta hanyar buga tambayoyi da ganin sakamako. Ba kwa buƙatar siyan komai. Zaɓi kayan aiki guda ɗaya kuma ku zauna tare da shi.

panel.rule: Yi bayanai kawai. Kada a taɓa manna ainihin bayanan abokin ciniki akan layi.

say: JOIN yana jera layuka daga teburi biyu duk inda maɓallan maɓalli suka yi daidai. JOIN CIKI yana kiyaye matches kawai. Shiga ba da umarni ga abokan ciniki yana ba da layuka 8, kowanne yanzu yana da suna da birni.

panel.heading: SHIGA CIKI da HANYAR HAGU
right: An adana duk layuka na teburin hagu
Funmi ta kasance tare da NULLs

say: HAGUWAR HAGU yana adana kowane jere na tebur na farko, ko da babu wasa. Rukunin da suka ɓace suna dawowa azaman NULL. Ta haka ne za ka sami wanda ya ɓace, kamar Funmi, abokin ciniki wanda bai taɓa samun oda ba.

panel.heading: SHIGA CIKI da HANYAR HAGU

say: Ta fara daga abokan ciniki, don haka babu wanda ya ɓace, kuma ta sanya matsayi daidai da aka kawo a cikin ON ɓangaren haɗin, ba a INA ba.

card.title: Kashe kowane abokin ciniki, gami da sifili
card.note: Yi ƙididdiga, ba farashin kasuwa na ainihi ba.

say: Dupe ya kashe naira 61,000, Amaka 55,000, Bisi 54,500, Efe 33,000 da Chioma 8,000. Funmi tana da 0, don haka ta sami tayin maraba.

card.title: Kashe kowane abokin ciniki, gami da sifili
card.note: Yi ƙididdiga, ba farashin kasuwa na ainihi ba.

say: Ya daidaita zuwa 211,500, jimlar da aka kawo.
Kuskure na gama gari: da ta sanya tacewa a INA, layin Funmi zai bace, kuma JOIN HAGU yayi shuru yayi kamar CIN JIKI.

card.title: Kashe kowane abokin ciniki, gami da sifili
card.note: Yi ƙididdiga, ba farashin kasuwa na ainihi ba.

say: Tambayar da ke gudana ba tare da kuskure ba koyaushe ba daidai ba ce. Ngozi ta tara adadin odar bayan shiga don yin odar kayayyaki, kuma ta sami 293,500.

card.title: Me yasa kudaden shiga suka yi tsalle ba zato ba tsammani?
card.note: Yi ƙididdiga, ba farashin kasuwa na ainihi ba.

say: Amma adadin da aka bayar da aka sani shine 211,500.

card.title: Me yasa kudaden shiga suka yi tsalle ba zato ba tsammani?
card.note: Yi ƙididdiga, ba farashin kasuwa na ainihi ba.

say: Tazarar ita ce 82,000. Bayan haɗawa akwai layuka 11, ba 8 ba, saboda umarni uku suna da layin samfur guda biyu kowanne, don haka ana ƙidaya kowanne sau biyu. Ana kiran wannan fan-out.
Gwajin mai sauri: kwatanta tauraro COUNT tare da COUNT DISTINCT oda ID. Idan na farko ya girma kuma na biyu bai yi ba, layuka suna maimaitawa.

say: Bincike guda biyar yana kama mafi yawan kurakuran shiru. Shin lissafin layin yana da ma'ana? Shin jimlar sun daidaita? Akwai fan-out? Ana sarrafa NULLs da gangan, misali tare da COALESCE don juya ƙimar da ta ɓace zuwa 0? Kuma kun tabo-duba layuka biyu?

panel.heading: Kafin ka raba lamba
items: Lissafin layi yana da ma'ana
Jimlar sulhu
Babu shiga fan-out
NULLs ana sarrafa su da gangan
Layuka biyu an duba tabo

say: Don tunawa. Bincika ƙididdiga da jimillarsu da zarar an ɗora bayanai. Yi amfani da CIN JOIN don abin da aka sayar da HAGU HAGU na wanda ya ɓace. Watch don fan-out. Kuma kada ku raba lambar da ba ku yi sulhu ba.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Duba kididdigar jere da jimlar bayan lodawa
INCER yana kiyaye matches; HAGU yana kiyaye kowa
Tace-tebur na dama na HAGUWAR HAGU sun shiga ON
Fan-out inflates jimlar; gwada tare da COUNT DISTINCT
Kada ku taɓa raba lambar da ba ku yi sulhu ba

say: Yanzu gina kuma tabbatar da bayanan aikin ku, amsa tambayoyin haɗin kai guda uku, sannan duba tambaya mara kyau.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
